caption:
Why does mixing three things make the science harder, not easier? 🔬 With one ingredient, an effect has one possible cause. With three, there are seven possible combinations to blame — so if something goes wrong, nobody can say which one did it.

That is why trials test one thing at a time: pepsafe.info
